scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "apps/**/*.{ts,tsx,json,css,html}" "packages/**/*.{ts,json}" "features/steps/*.mjs" "scripts/*.mjs" docker-compose.yml package.json eslint.config.js tsconfig.test.json vitest.config.ts .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @home-memory/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @home-memory/web && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.pretest:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api
scripts.pretest:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api
scripts.pretest:bdd: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api
scripts.test:providers:live: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && node scripts/provider-smoke.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:ui && npm run test:bdd && npm run test:release
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
